proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Relating to Action by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board permit shareholders holding the minimum votes needed to authorize action to act by written consent, consistent with applicable law.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Relating to Independent Board Chairman
proposals.proponent: Myra K. Young (introduced by John Chevedden)
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director, with discretion to phase in at the next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.
